rationale: The price has failed to hold the 9-EMA and is showing weakness by trading back toward the daily low, invalidating the immediate mean-reversion thesis. With the broader market (SPY) down significantly and the position already testing the lower bound of the range, the risk of a breakdown below the $73.40 invalidation level outweighs the potential for a recovery. Closing now preserves the remaining daily loss budget and avoids further exposure to a momentum-driven sell-off.
